item.title: GOP officials abandon efforts to sway Trump
item.description: Top White House officials and elected Republicans privately admit they no longer attempt to persuade President Trump on decisions, according to sources...

item.title: Anthropic insiders warn AI could wipe out humanity
item.description: Three researchers from Anthropic publicly voiced serious concerns about unregulated AI, suggesting it might pose an existential threat within this decade.

item.title: OpenAI urges caution in the AI development race
item.description: Tech leaders face a dilemma: slowing AI progress may mean losing competitive edge, but accelerating could bring unforeseen risks.

item.title: Vance-aligned donor network hosts influential GOP figures in Dallas
